01

Purpose of Visual You

Visual You is a self-improvement and habit-tracking application. It allows users to:

Record beneficial and unwanted habits.

Track exercises, water consumption, nutrition, sleep, screen time, and other activities.

Display symbolic organ and muscle progress.

Create gradual-growth and gradual-reduction plans.

View calendars, graphs, heatmaps, streaks, badges, and progress reports.

Use optional AI-powered coaching.

Use optional backup, synchronization, widgets, advertisements, and premium features.

Visual You is intended to support awareness, organization, motivation, and personal reflection.

02

Medical and health disclaimer

Visual You is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice, diagnoses, treatment, monitoring, or emergency services.

Body, organ, muscle, performance, ingredient, exposure, and condition colors are symbolic calculations based on information entered into the app. They do not represent the actual health or medical condition of any organ, muscle, body part, or person.

Points, colors, percentages, graphs, labels such as “good,” “excellent,” or “needs attention,” and AI responses must not be interpreted as medical findings.

You should consult a qualified healthcare professional before making significant changes involving:

Alcohol, nicotine, vaping, caffeine, or other substances.

Addiction or compulsive behavior.

Nutrition, fasting, hydration, or exercise.

Mental health or sexual wellbeing.

An existing illness, pregnancy, injury, medication, or treatment.

Suddenly reducing or stopping alcohol or another substance may be dangerous for someone who is dependent on it. Seek professional medical assistance before attempting withdrawal.

If you believe you are experiencing a medical or mental-health emergency, contact your local emergency services immediately. Do not rely on Visual You or its AI Coach.

03

Gradual plans

Gradual-growth and gradual-reduction calendars are organizational tools only. Their schedules are not medical treatment plans and do not mean that performing an unwanted habit on a scheduled day is healthy, recommended, or risk-free.

Users may change, pause, miss, or discontinue a plan. The Service cannot guarantee that a plan is suitable, safe, or effective for a particular user.

Eligibility and minors

You must be at least 16 years old to use Visual You.

If you are below the age at which you may legally consent to online services in your country, a parent or legal guardian must review and accept these Terms for you.

Features involving alcohol, adult content, sexual behavior, or other age-restricted subjects are intended only for adults and may be restricted for users identified as under 18.

You must provide an accurate birth date. We may suspend access if we reasonably believe that age information is inaccurate or that use of the Service creates a legal or safety risk.

Local storage, backup, and device transfer

Visual You is designed primarily as a local-first application. Habit records and other app information may remain only on your device unless you use an online back up feature.

Uninstalling the app, clearing its storage, losing the device, or experiencing device failure may permanently delete locally stored information.

Eligible users may request a temporary device-transfer backup. Unless otherwise stated in the app, this backup is retained for up to 10 days and may then be automatically deleted.

We do not guarantee that every backup, restoration, synchronization, or transfer will complete successfully. You remain responsible for confirming that important information has transferred correctly before deleting it from an old device.

The AI Coach may generate responses using automated artificial-intelligence systems supplied by us or third-party providers.

AI responses may be incomplete, outdated, inaccurate, inappropriate, or misleading. They are provided for general information and motivation only and must not be treated as professional medical, psychological, legal, financial, or emergency advice.

Do not submit information, images, or documents that you do not have permission to share. Avoid sending unnecessary identifying or highly sensitive information.

We may limit AI usage according to the user’s subscription plan, token balance, safety requirements, technical capacity, or provider availability.
